sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Deliver a production sprite sheet, not a concept illustration. MAX is a tiny side-view pixel-art night-garden game: organic silhouettes, near-black/blue-black outlines, muted moss and teal palette, small warm accent pixels. EXACT 8 columns x 8 rows, 64 sprites, equally spaced cell boundaries, canvas 1024x1024, no margins, no text, no grid lines, genuine transparent background. EACH cell is a native 16x16 pixel tile magnified exactly 8x: hard square 8x8 colour blocks, at most 12 colours, NO smaller details, NO antialiasing, NO gradients/glow/ground/shadow. Body is only 7–12 native pixels across/high, visibly much smaller than a 24px-tall player. Same centre x=8, foot/hover baseline y=15 per tile. Facing RIGHT. Nothing crosses a cell boundary. Each row shows 8 sequential temporal frames of ONE consistent creature; columns are frames, not separate characters. Row 0 idle/breath; row 1 movement cycle; row 2 anticipation/wind-up (amber signal grows); row 3 attack and clear release; row 4 recovery; row 5 hurt/stagger; row 6 non-gory death collapse/dissolve (last frame empty); row 7 special behaviour specified below. Retain recognisable silhouette in every row. Creature: a tiny hunched, swift seed-stealing garden weevil with a pointed forward snout, two thin antennae, long rear legs, dark teal shell and a small tan seed sack on its back. Black outline #111819, dark teal #1d3b38, moss #415540, muted ochre #ae8950, pale seed #d4bd78. Its silhouette is a low triangular head plus round sack, not a bird. Attack is a forward snatch with snout and forelegs, no weapons. Movement is a quick 8-frame scuttle. Row 7 is running while clutching one clearly visible pale round seed in its forelegs; do not draw numbers or text.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production low-resolution pixel-art final boss sprite sheet for MAX, matching a subdued organic side-view night-garden game. ONE boss, HOLLOW CROWN: an ancient hollow dark-teal woody trunk with a black open centre, a broken asymmetric moss crown of five short branches on top, root-claw legs underneath, a tiny internal light. No human skull, armour, jewels or giant landscape. Body native 24x28 inside a 32x32 cell, foot anchor (16,31). Sharp blocky contours and at most 14 muted colours: ink #10171c, blue-black #1d2b34, teal #2b4645, moss #536448, bark #605047, muted cream #b5b190. AMBER #d4a64e is strictly attack wind-up; CYAN #77bbb9 is strictly exposed/vulnerable inner core. Exact 8 columns by 16 rows (128 animation frames), aspect 1:2, requested canvas1024x2048. Each cell128x128 is native32x32 enlarged4x; all pixels hard4x4 blocks, binary alpha transparent background, no labels/text/gridlines/margins/glow/gradients/shadows/scenery. Same foot anchor and stable body scale in EVERY frame, facing slightly RIGHT, full body contained within each cell. Rows 0–4 PHASE1: [idle, amber windup, root-swipe attack, recover, cyan vulnerable]; columns 0–7 eight temporal frames of each row. Rows 5–9 PHASE2 repeat same five states with crown split open slightly and two longer root arms; core stays dark except vulnerable/amber windup. Rows10–14 PHASE3 repeat five states with crown opened into three broken prongs and hollow trunk spread wider, retaining same identity and scale. Row15 death: eight frames crown folds inward, roots collapse, trunk breaks into a few dark pixels, final frame empty. Vulnerable rows expose a BLACK hollow ring around a cyan 2–3 pixel core, not an all-cyan body. Windup coils roots and amber core visibly builds, attacks have a readable single-frame extension. No motion blur, no random different monsters.
sources.processing: Connected-component extraction at alpha>=128, registered by crown centre, 0.30 nearest-neighbour scale, extended reaches fitted to 32px cell; final death fragments separately cropped. See crown-packing.json.
